entities.summary: Michelle Amos is an electronics design engineer at NASA's John F. Kennedy Space Center. Amos joined NASA in 1990 as an electronics design engineer and stayed with Nasa for 30 years. Amos was also a systems engineer for Deep Space Logistics.
